logo_type.rationale: A restrained symbol can carry the living-layer and replay ideas at small sizes, while the Cambium wordmark keeps the unfamiliar product category legible. The symbol must work independently only after recognition is established.

visual_concepts: a thin living ring inside older growth rings
an open path that bends inward before crossing a boundary
a C-shaped cambium layer that is neither tree clip-art nor a loading spinner
one copper intervention point inside a stable lichen structure
symbol_ideas: Offset Ring: three imperfect concentric rings with one open copper layer forming a subtle C.
Viable Path: a single line approaches an enclosing ring, curves inward, and continues.
Living Ledger: two nested arcs with one small copper notch marking the current decision.

references.gap_opportunity: Cambium needs a more distinctive organic operating symbol, not retail minimalism.

references.what_works: A natural form reduced into a recognizable silhouette.
references.gap_opportunity: Avoid a literal tree and communicate controlled continuity rather than conservation.

references.what_works: Instrument-like clarity, disciplined proportion, and durable form.
references.gap_opportunity: Add living asymmetry and warmth so the system does not feel industrial or closed.

concept_directions.name: Living Boundary
concept_directions.concept: Three quiet concentric growth rings. The middle ring opens into a subtle letter C and continues as a path that bends inward before crossing the outer boundary. One small copper segment marks human consequence.
concept_directions.style_notes: Flat two-color symbol, imperfect botanical curvature disciplined by geometric spacing, no trunk, leaf, roots, arrows, or 3D effects.
concept_directions.generation_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: symbol exploration for Cambium, the Infinite Game Engine. Primary request: create one simple flat emblem built from three imperfect concentric growth rings; the middle living layer forms a subtle open letter C and continues as a path that curves inward before crossing the outer boundary; include one very small copper intervention segment. Style/medium: vector-friendly flat mark, organic geometry, archival restraint. Color palette: Living Lichen #1F3A2E and Cambium Copper #B76E3F. Composition: centered isolated symbol, strong silhouette, generous negative space, genuinely transparent background. Constraints: no wordmark, no letters drawn literally, no tree, leaf, roots, robot, brain, infinity symbol, arrows, gradient, glow, bevel, mockup, watermark, or extra text.

concept_directions.name: Viable Path
concept_directions.concept: A continuous line enters a bounded oval, approaches its edge, then changes course and keeps moving inside it.
concept_directions.style_notes: Monoline, calm tension, asymmetric but balanced; reads as continuation rather than optimization.
concept_directions.generation_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: alternate Cambium symbol. Primary request: a single continuous monoline path inside a softly irregular oval boundary; the path approaches the edge, bends inward, and continues, conveying viability and an infinite game without using an infinity sign. Style: minimal organic geometry, precise spacing, flat. Palette: #1F3A2E with one #B76E3F node. Transparent background. No text, arrows, leaves, robots, brains, gradients, glow, or mockup.

concept_directions.name: Decision Ring
concept_directions.concept: Nested rings preserve history while a single offset notch records the current stewarded choice.
concept_directions.style_notes: Most compact direction; suitable for favicon and provenance stamps.
concept_directions.generation_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: compact Cambium provenance mark. Primary request: two nested imperfect rings with one offset copper notch that feels like a recorded human decision. Strong small-size silhouette, flat vector-friendly construction, centered on transparent background. Use #1F3A2E and #B76E3F only. No letters, trees, leaves, infinity symbols, gradients, glow, or text.

usage_specs.clear_space: One copper-notch width around the symbol; one cap-height around the combination mark.
dont_do: Do not close the living layer into a static target or loading spinner.
Do not add leaf, tree, root, robot, brain, or game-controller imagery.
Do not use copper for more than the single consequence segment.
Do not rotate the mark or animate it as endless activity.
Do not treat a generated raster concept as a production vector master.

data.asset_status: concept-approved-for-generation; production vectorization and human mark approval remain separate
